articles.title: USACE Mobile District permitting action supports former USS Enterprise arrival and dismantling in Mobile
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Mobile District helped prepare for the arrival and dismantling of the former USS Enterprise (CVN 65) by reviewing and authorizing waterfront improvements at MARRS’ Yard 8 in Mobile.

articles.title: Goodfellow AFB leadership joins the community in recognizing Veterans Day
articles.summary: In observance of Veterans Day, 17th Training Wing leadership joined the community on Nov. 11, 2026, to honor the service, sacrifice and enduring legacy of those who raised their right hand and served the United States of America.

articles.title: Utah National Guard, Granite School District celebrate veterans at 71st Annual Veterans Day Concert
articles.summary: The Utah National Guard and Granite School District honored America’s veterans through music, student performances and recognition of military service during the 71st Annual Veterans Day Concert on Nov. 11, 2026, at the Tabernacle at Temple Square.

articles.title: Hancock County arts educator experiences life aboard USS Nimitz
articles.summary: NAVAL CONSTRUCTION BATTALION CENTER GULFPORT, Miss. – For most Americans, the opportunity to visit a U.S. Navy aircraft carrier is something they will never experience.

articles.title: AMCOM 101 links aviation readiness to enterprise support
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Aviation and Missile Command brought together Soldiers, civilians and aviation enterprise partners Nov. 4-5 at Bob Jones Auditorium for its fall AMCOM 101 Aviation Conference, a biannual forum focused on connecting unit readiness challenges with the people and resources that support Army aviation.

articles.title: U.S. Naval War College Holds November Graduation For Students of Colleges of Naval Warfare, Naval Command & Staff
articles.summary: The U.S. Naval War College (NWC) graduated 29 students from its Colleges of Naval Warfare (CNW) and Naval Command & Staff (CNCS) on Friday, Nov. 13, 2026.

articles.title: C. J. Graham Visits USS Essex (LHD 2)
articles.summary: SAN DIEGO (Oct. 29, 2026) Actor C. J. Graham visited Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Essex (LHD 2) to tour the ship and meet with U.S. Navy Sailors.

articles.title: US Air Force adopts new Force Design focusing on sensors and autonomy
articles.summary: The Air Force's new Force Design 2026 outlines a shift toward artificial intelligence, autonomy and integrated sensors to counter emerging threats.

articles.title: New Hampshire National Guard breaks ground on new Plymouth Readiness Center
articles.summary: The New Hampshire Army National Guard broke ground Nov. 12 on the Plymouth Readiness Center, beginning a $31 million project to replace the community’s 1957 armory with a modern, secure facility built for current and future missions.

articles.title: Air Force Band ensembles honor veterans across the nation
articles.summary: The U.S. Air Force Band's Ceremonial Brass performed live at NBC's TODAY Show plaza, Nov. 11, 2026, anchoring a series of nationwide performances honoring America’s veterans through music.

articles.title: Judges close part of ICC Afghanistan investigations that could look at US troops
articles.summary: The International Criminal Court will close investigations into Afghanistan that previously looked at alleged crimes by U.S. troops and focus only on actions of the Taliban.

articles.title: WHY I Serve: Soldier’s Determination Leads Her to Army Service at 41
articles.summary: At 41, many people have settled into established careers and routines. Pfc. Olivia Kabre, a nutrition care specialist at Landstuhl Regional Medical Center, chose a different path: She enlisted in the U.S. Army and completed basic combat training, pursuing a goal she had held for years.

articles.title: Oregon Guard Soldiers bring Army fitness, Veterans Day lesson to Salem middle school
articles.summary: Three Oregon Army National Guard Soldiers spent the day before Veterans Day at Crossler Middle School, leading students through Army-style physical training and talking with them about the veterans in their own families.

articles.title: WRAIR-AFRIMS protects force health at Super Garuda Shield 2026
articles.summary: The Walter Reed Army Institute of Research – Armed Forces Research Institute of Medical Sciences, in partnership with the Australian Defence Force Malaria and Infectious Diseases Institute, conducted real-time infectious disease surveillance in support of Super Garuda Shield 2026.

articles.title: Pentagon rebrands principle AI shop as ‘Super Intelligence Office’
articles.summary: The redesignation follows President Donald Trump’s push to replace references to artificial intelligence with “super intelligence” across the federal government.

articles.title: US Army names officer held on ‘allegations of espionage’
articles.summary: Lt. Col. Brandon Carroll Tyner has been identified as the U.S. soldier arrested earlier this week in the UK for reportedly assisting Russian intelligence.
